references.assessment: A fixed Feature owned via FeatureMembership is featured by its owningType. The implied owning-Type contribution is computed by the resolved shared FeatureAdapter; concrete Usage getters consume mayTimeVary rather than raw isVariable storage.

The featuringType derivation combines typeFeaturing endpoints with the featuringTypes of the first chainingFeature, preserving uniqueness. Native includes explicit relationships, the fixed owning-Type contribution, and first-chain recursion. The last chain is not used for featuring.

disagreements.assessment: The written derivation uses all inverse typeFeaturing relationships; Pilot reads ownedTypeFeaturing. Native continues to reject externally owned inverse relationships pending normative assessment rather than silently omit them.

boundaries: Variable snapshot construction does not become a read-only query; unresolved inputs reject
Usage variability still requires resolved library/generalization inputs
Explicit fixture libraries and supplied complete owner inputs are observation controls, not actual library lifecycle qualification
Detached specialized, cross-feature, value-expression and unresolved variant contributions retain their separate consumers/guards
Binding structure placement is verified separately from full connector/end transformation
